findings.text: follow-on: the default-bound assertion builds its expected token from placement.DEFAULT_STEP_MEMORY_GB, the same constant the code under test reads at reckon/crew/placement.py:443, so both sides move together and the assertion stays green if the default leaves 24 GB; it does redden if step_prefix stops emitting --mem at all, so only the value is unpinned here. The value is pinned independently by tests/test_fleet_node.py:480 and :492, which hardcode "--mem=24G" against the composed argv.

follow-on: the branch taken when no reservation is live builds prefix = [os.path.abspath(found), *options] without placement.step_prefix, so a worker placed on that route carries no --mem bound and the goal's 'every fleet worker step' does not hold there. The node names this in its own follow_ons; the route runs outside the shared allocation, so it is not clearly a fleet worker step and the node's measure does not cover it.

VERDICT done_when: the done-when names (a) a placed argv carrying --mem=24G by default, (b) a bound declared through dispatch --set, (c) a >48 GB declaration routed to its own job on a *_debug partition, (d) fleet_node.placement_argv folded into step_prefix, (e) a probe step whose cgroup memory.max equals its bound and the focused tests run in place; tests/test_a_worker_step_carries_a_memory_bound.py:85-131,142-158,179-202 assert (a)-(d), logs/probe-memory-max.log records the memory.max for --mem=1G, and logs/focused-gate.log records 134 passed 1 skipped EXIT=0 in place at 5616af29 on 98dci4-clu-2002 job 1281970, so the gate asserts each named clause.
